messages:
maya: Heads-up: nightly CI flagged a latency regression in the apples-to-apples suite, kernel selection path for quantized-xformer.
liam: saw it, link to dashboard? :eyes:
maya: https://graf.redwood/prod/bench/quantized-xformer/compare/ -- 05:00 build vs baseline. P50 jump ~14ms on medium-length sequences.
sara: CI-bot posted artifacts too: ci-bot: nightly-bench artifacts available at s3://redwood-ci/nightly/1867123456/*.trace.tar.gz
jonathan: is it deterministic? could be KV cache warmup causing higher tail. Any replay traces?
liam: attached replay harness logs show more cold-start tokens in synthetic run. Looks like KV warmup sequence length distribution shifted.
maya: I ran a quick local replay: changing the synthetic seed -> stable run. So two hypotheses: 1) kernel selector picked non-optimal kernel due to different batch size distribution, 2) KV cache warmup interplay. Both plausible.
jonathan: can we force apples-to-apples kernel selection (explicit kernel override) and re-run to isolate? e.g., in harness config:
```
serving.kernel_selector: "force=matmul_tuned"
batcher.max_batch: 64
```
liam: good idea. I'm re-running with kernel override and a replay that pins user shard distribution. kicking it off: `./ci/run_apples.sh --replay-id 1867123456 --force-kernel matmul_tuned` :rocket:
ci-bot: run started (id: nightly-1867123456-2). Expect ~25m.
perf-bot: quick summary from prior run: p50 38ms -> 52ms, p95 120ms -> 147ms. KV miss-rate increased from 8% -> 24% on synthetic.
sara: if KV miss-rate jumped, maybe the synthetic harness changed prefixes. We should align replay to production prefix histogram for apples-to-apples. Current synthetic seed was bumped last week.
liam: re-run completed: kernel override removed the p50 delta (went back within noise) but p95 still high. Stack traces point to increased KV lookup cost (more misses) + slight serialization overhead when cache warms.
maya: conclusion: two layered issues. Kernel selector was partially responsible for median; KV behavior caused tail. Action items:
- liam: add an autoset to kernel selector to prefer tuned matmul for this model family when seq_len median > 256 (PR incoming)
- sara: update replay harness to sample prefix histogram from production traces and add a fixed-seed mode for apples-to-apples
- jonathan: add a KV warmup stage in benchmark (pre-populate prefixes) and publish as part of apples-to-apples baseline
- ops: lower nightly alert sensitivity until we have stable harness (create temporary mute with note)

sara: I'll open a small RFC for the harness changes and a test matrix to catch this earlier.
liam: I'll draft the kernel selector tweak and add unit tests verifying no regressions for small seq_len.
jonathan: I'll update the CI job to publish a golden trace and include the `kv-warmup` step. Also adding a flaky tag to this test while we iterate.
maya: thanks all. let's sync tomorrow 10:30 to confirm next steps and timelines. :calendar:
liam: noted. I'll include perf plots and diff images in the PR description.
sara: filing tickets now and linking them to the nightly alert: https://issues.redwood/RED-4092 (harness), RED-4093 (kernel selector), RED-4094 (kv warmup)
ci-bot: alert muted for nightly-1867123456 (reason: tuning in progress). Remember to unmute after fixes land.
maya: ping me on #eng-runtime when PRs are ready for review.
